scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/ensure-dir.mjs emulator-data && concurrently -k -n fn,emu,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix functions run build:watch" "firebase emulators:start --only auth,functions,firestore --import=./emulator-data --export-on-exit" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
